//: Two npm projects share this file. `functions/` deploys and runs the Cloud Functions; the repo root runs the security-rules suite (rules_test/). Both drive the emulators through `firebase emulators:exec`, which is why the ports are pinned here rather than passed on each command line.

firestore.//: firestore.rules is the ruleset the rules suite loads verbatim — a test against a copy would be a statement about a file nobody deploys. The collection-group index on entries.uid is what lets deleteAccount find a player's leaderboard entries.

emulators.//: `npm run test:rules` (root) needs only firestore. `npm run test:emulator` (functions/) also needs auth, for deleteAccount's auth-record deletion. The UI is off because both entry points are non-interactive.
